push.title: W 8-2 vs Los Condenados | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #4)
push.body:
buddskees, they don't make the rating any higher than that. Perfect Game #4 against Los Condenados. Somebody ring a bell.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 4th Perfect Game for us. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 29 passes (up from your usual 18). Always available, always an option.
+ 2 key passes. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ A goal against Los Condenados. The goal was open and you walked right through the door.
+ Man of the Match, your 8th for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Low-hanging fruit: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. Trust the work.
- Lowest goals on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 4). Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. Keep it simple.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. Middle of the pack for a midfielder; the top quarter hits 87%+. Room to climb.

Work on: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Before you go, buddskees: The best time to plant a tree was yesterday. The second best is next match.

Keep that fire burning. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 8-2 vs Los Condenados | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #7)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 10.0. Perfect Game #7. I've been coaching a long time and I still got goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 7th Perfect Game for us. That right there is what good teammates do.
+ 93% passing on 28 attempts, up from your usual 79%. Your passes were cleaner than a Sunday shirt.
+ 7 shots at Los Condenados's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ 2 key passes. That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ You and BellyTb1 were finishing each other's sentences out there.

THE BAD
- Lowest shot conversion on the team: 43% (best was buddskees's 50%). Golden rule: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 1 (best was BellyTb1's 4). It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- On-ball actions 36, from 57 in your previous match. That's the stone in your boot. Take it out.

Fundamentals drill: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Proud of you, partner. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 8-2 vs Los Condenados | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #2)
push.body:
Perfect Game #2, BellyTb1. A 10.0 against Los Condenados. If football had a dictionary, your picture would be next to 'flawless'.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 2nd Perfect Game for us. Bottle that and bring it next match.
+ Goal involvements 6, up from your usual 1. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ 1 key pass. You're the opener on the team's toolbelt.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 7.8. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ You found PhogsToffees and PhogsToffees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.

THE BAD
- Lowest key passes on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 2). Tiny tweak: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was buddskees's 0). Here's a thought: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.
- 2 goals conceded: -0.1. Easy points to win back.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 52% (11 of 21). I've seen tidier yard sales. Little adjustment: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

Homework: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Believe in yourself the way your dog believes in you.

I'm gonna go tell my plant about you. - Coach Lasso
